name: guards
description: Hooks that stop destructive Bash operations, deletion of unmerged worktrees and pushes from a branch behind the default branch, `gh issue view --comments` without `--json` (gh-comments-guard) and `pip freeze` (pip-freeze-guard), and bring the local merge-target branch up to date after a merge. Optional publish-guard: checks issue / PR text against your own list of private-value patterns before it is published to a public repo. Repo layout rules apply only when you add a rule file. In the desktop app, link-check stops Claude once when its last reply links a file the file pane cannot open

worktree_dirs.title: Folders where you keep worktrees
worktree_dirs.description: Comma-separated (e.g. ~/.worktrees). Recursive deletes under these are allowed, and paths that can't be confirmed as merged are blocked. If empty, no folder gets special treatment (deleting an unmerged worktree is blocked anywhere)

publish_patterns.title: Private-value patterns for publish-guard
publish_patterns.description: JSON array of regexes, e.g. ["acme-internal", "(?i)acme-[a-z]+-private"]. Issue / PR text that matches one is blocked before it is published to a public GitHub repo. Empty turns the check off

link_check.title: link-check mode (enforce / observe / off)
link_check.description: Desktop app only. enforce: when Claude's last reply links a file the file pane cannot open (missing, or outside the working directory, added directories and scratchpad), stop it once and ask for a fix. observe: only record the fire in the plugin's data directory. off: do nothing
